verdict.rationale: Docs show event-based triggers (create_item, change_column_value, agent mentions/assignments) that fire automated actions, plus rule-based agent building ("Define the goal, set the rules, watch the results") and scheduled automations for reports. This directly matches the story of defining rules that trigger actions on events. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of automation reliability at scale, and no detail on conditional logic complexity beyond simple event subscriptions.
